## Walkthrough

Dial surfaces now drop rotate, press, and touch input when no dial context exists. Deck-core provides a shared frozen no-op hold preview. Dial property inspectors use a shared controller-resolution and view-switching partial, with tests and guidance updated for these patterns.

### Changes

**Dial Surface Context Handling and Shared Preview**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|:---|:---|
|**Shared context and preview primitives** <br> `packages/iracing-actions/src/shared/dial-context.ts`, `packages/deck-core/src/dial-gesture.ts`, `packages/deck-core/src/index.ts`, `packages/deck-core/src/dial-gesture.test.ts`, `.claude/rules/encoders-and-touchscreen.md`, `packages/deck-adapter-ulanzi/CLAUDE.md`, `packages/iracing-actions/CLAUDE.md`|Adds `hasDialInputContext` and the `DialInputEvent` type. Exports the frozen `NOOP_HOLD_PREVIEW` from deck-core. Updates guidance on lifecycle-created contexts and dropped input.|
|**Guard input across dial surfaces** <br> `packages/iracing-actions/src/actions/*/*dial-surface.ts`, `packages/iracing-actions/src/actions/*/*dial-surface.test.ts`, `packages/iracing-actions/src/actions/*/*.test.ts`|Dial input handlers check for an existing context before processing events. Tests initialize live dial contexts through lifecycle events and verify that late input does not recreate contexts or trigger side effects.|

**Shared Dial Property Inspector Controller**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|:---|:---|
|**Shared controller partial and inspector migration** <br> `packages/pi-components/partials/dial-controller.ejs`, `packages/iracing-actions/src/actions/*/*.ejs`|Adds shared controller resolution and dial-view helpers. Dial-capable inspector templates include the partial and call its helpers instead of local implementations. Audio Controls retains its dial-specific binding visibility logic.|
|**Inspector checks and guidance** <br> `packages/pi-components/src/build/dial-pi-knob-gating.test.ts`, `.claude/rules/pi-templates.md`, `.claude/rules/stream-deck-actions.md`, `packages/iracing-actions/CLAUDE.md`|Adds checks for partial inclusion, controller resolution, view visibility, and compiled helper placement. Documents the shared inspector pattern.|
